findings.evidence: Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:32 `structure ExclKinematics` already carries p, pPrime, k, kPrime, q, qPrime, hqLepton, hMomentum; the PR's own module docstring (line 60-61) states 'No data beyond the exclusive record is needed at this layer.'
findings.fix: Delete the structure. Define `xi`, `beta`, `MX2` and `x_eq_xi_mul_beta` on `K : ExclKinematics V` (e.g. `namespace ExclKinematics` with a `Diffractive`-flavoured section, or `namespace Diffractive` taking `ExclKinematics V`), so the statement becomes `K.toDisKinematics.xBj g = K.xi g * K.beta g`. Add fields only when a later layer actually needs data beyond the exclusive record.
findings.issue: `structure DiffractiveKinematics (V) ... extends ExclKinematics V` adds no fields; it is a thin wrapper type identical to `ExclKinematics V`, forcing every inherited lemma and `toDisKinematics` to go through `D.toExclKinematics` (see the theorem statement `D.toExclKinematics.toDisKinematics.xBj g`).

findings.evidence: Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:64 `def delta (K : ExclKinematics V) : V := K.pPrime - K.p`; line 91 `lemma delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime (K) : K.delta = K.q - K.qPrime`; Diffractive/Basic.lean:92 `rw [Delta_def, ExclKinematics.delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime, neg_sub]`.
findings.fix: Drop all three declarations. Write `xi g K := -g K.delta K.q / g K.p K.q` and `beta g K := K.Q2 g / (2 * -g K.delta K.q)` (or `-(K.Q2 g) / (2 * g K.delta K.q)`), and where `q' - q` is needed use `K.delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime` with `neg_sub` inline.
findings.issue: `Delta := -D.delta`, `Delta_def`, and `Delta_eq_qPrime_sub_q` duplicate the existing `ExclKinematics.delta` and `ExclKinematics.delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime` up to a sign; the new lemma's proof is exactly `delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime` followed by `neg_sub`. The record now exposes two names (`D.delta`, `D.Delta`) for ± the same vector.

findings.evidence: Kinematics/Basic.lean:45 `hq : q = k - kPrime` is Prop-valued, so `Subsingleton.elim _ _` (or `rfl`) closes the goal independently of the definition.
findings.fix: Delete the lemma; the five `@[simp]` projection lemmas above it are the complete interface.
findings.issue: `toDisKinematics_hq : K.toDisKinematics.hq = K.hqLepton` equates two proofs of the Prop `q = k - kPrime`; by proof irrelevance it holds for any definition of `toDisKinematics` and states nothing.

summary: `DiffractiveKinematics V` is a field-free `extends ExclKinematics V`, so the existing `ExclKinematics V` directly replaces it; `Delta` and its two lemmas are a sign-flipped parallel of the existing `ExclKinematics.delta` API. The genuinely new material (`xi`, `beta`, `MX2`, `x_eq_xi_mul_beta`, `toDisKinematics`) should be stated directly on `ExclKinematics`.
